spans.s:
mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Watery, aquatic, of or belonging to water.
E.
उदक, and ठञ् aff.

m. (-कः)
A cook.
E.
ओदन boiled rice, and ठक् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Selfishly voracious.
E.
उदर the belly, and ठक् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ती-तं)
Made of buttermilk, &c.
n. (-तं)
Buttermilk with an equal proportion of water.
E.
उदश्वित the same, and अण् affix; or with कस् added औदश्वित्क.

n. (-र्य्यं)
Magnanimity, generosity, greatness.
E.
उदार liberal, and ष्यञ् aff.

n. (-ष्यं)
Philosophy, stoicism, indifference.
E.
उदास, and ष्यञ् aff.

n. (-कं)
A bitter and acrid substance like honey, said to be found in the nest of the white ant.
